mapper.insert: INSERT INTO etf_fund_flow_summary ( etf_code, etf_name, trade_date, fund_share_today, share_change, close_price, fund_flow, cumulative_flow, ann_date, change_reason ) SELECT f.etf_code, m.symbol AS etf_name, f.trade_date, f.fund_share_today, f.share_change, f.close_price, f.fund_flow, 0 AS cumulative_flow, f.ann_date, f.change_reason FROM ( -- 用 etf_security_master 拿到每个 etf 的 market（SH/SZ）， -- 配合 trade_calendar 找"上一交易日"，全程不碰 etf_market_kline 做 GROUP BY SELECT t1.etf_code, t1.change_date AS trade_date, t1.ann_date, t1.fund_share AS fund_share_today, COALESCE(t1.fund_share - prev.prev_fund_share, 0) AS share_change, t3.close_price, ROUND( COALESCE(t1.fund_share - prev.prev_fund_share, 0) * COALESCE(t3.close_price, 0) * 10000, 2 ) AS fund_flow, t1.change_reason FROM etf_fund_share t1 -- 一次性算出"每个 (etf, change_date) 的上一交易日 fund_share" LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fs.etf_code, fs.change_date, ( SELECT fs2.fund_share FROM etf_fund_share fs2 INNER JOIN etf_security_master sm ON sm.etf_code = fs.etf_code WHERE fs2.etf_code = fs.etf_code AND fs2.change_date = ( -- 上一交易日 = trade_calendar 中 market=sm.market 且 < fs.change_date 的最大交易日 SELECT MAX(tc2.trade_date) FROM trade_calendar tc2 WHERE tc2.market = sm.market AND tc2.is_open = 1 AND tc2.trade_date < fs.change_date ) LIMIT 1 ) AS prev_fund_share FROM etf_fund_share fs WHERE fs.change_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) prev ON prev.etf_code = t1.etf_code AND prev.change_date = t1.change_date -- close_price 用 etf_market_kline，但加 period 限制走索引 LEFT JOIN etf_market_kline t3 ON t3.period = 'day' AND t3.etf_code = t1.etf_code AND DATE(t3.trade_time) = t1.change_date WHERE t1.change_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) f LEFT JOIN etf_security_master m ON m.etf_code = f.etf_code ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE etf_name = VALUES(etf_name), fund_share_today = VALUES(fund_share_today), share_change = VALUES(share_change), close_price = VALUES(close_price), fund_flow = VALUES(fund_flow), ann_date = VALUES(ann_date), change_reason = VALUES(change_reason)
mapper.update: UPDATE etf_fund_flow_summary t JOIN ( SELECT c.etf_code, c.trade_date, ROUND( COALESCE(baseline.base, 0) + SUM(c.fund_flow) OVER ( PARTITION BY c.etf_code ORDER BY c.trade_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ), 2 ) AS cum_flow FROM etf_fund_flow_summary c -- 一次性算每个 etf 的"start_date 之前最后一条 cumulative_flow"基线 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s2.etf_code, s2.cumulative_flow AS base FROM etf_fund_flow_summary s2 INNER JOIN ( SELECT etf_code, MAX(trade_date) AS last_dt FROM etf_fund_flow_summary WHERE trade_date < #{startDate} AND cumulative_flow IS NOT NULL GROUP BY etf_code ) m ON m.etf_code = s2.etf_code AND m.last_dt = s2.trade_date WHERE s2.cumulative_flow IS NOT NULL ) baseline ON baseline.etf_code = c.etf_code WHERE c.trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) calc ON t.etf_code = calc.etf_code AND t.trade_date = calc.trade_date SET t.cumulative_flow = calc.cum_flow
